data.title: Bitcoin, Ethereum and XRP Prices Brace For Jobs Report Week as Fed Decision Looms
data.description: Bitcoin is trading at $78,796.58, Ethereum at $2,478.28 and XRP at $1.40 as traders brace for a week loaded with U.S. labor market data that could shape the Federal Reserve’s next policy move and, by extension, crypto’s near-term direction.Current Market SnapshotThe Data Calendar Traders Are Watchi…
